introduction: Hub keeps its own record binding a personal access token (PAT) to exactly one workspace, keyed by apikit's token id, and enforces it in the REST API (a post-authentication guard on the API group, a pre-authentication deny-only guard on apikit's own routes, and the shared rule in internal/wsaccess) and in the git server, so a bound token reaches only its own workspace under its scopes while every unbound credential behaves exactly as before.

glossary.S: The workspace slug named by a bound token's binding row.
glossary.apikit route guard: The pre-authentication, deny-only middleware on the root Echo instance that refuses bound tokens on the routes apikit's MountHandlers registers.
glossary.binding: A row in the SQLite table token_workspace_bindings that ties a PAT's token id to one workspace slug.
glossary.binding guard: The post-authentication middleware on the API group that confines bound tokens: 404 for other slugs, 403 token_bound for non-allowlisted routes.
glossary.bound token: A PAT (CredentialType "pat") whose token id has a binding row. Every other credential is unbound.
glossary.bound-token allowlist: The registry in internal/wsaccess of *echo.Route values (method plus path template) that a bound token may call although they are not workspace-scoped; their results are filtered to S.
glossary.pkt-line error: The git smart-HTTP error framing written by the git server's writePktLineError.
glossary.token_bound: The error_type value in the apikit error envelope returned when a bound token calls a route that cannot be workspace-scoped.
glossary.workspace-scoped route: An API route whose path template (echo c.Path()) contains the segment workspaces followed by the segment :slug.

requirements.title: The binding record
requirements.rationale: Hub must own the binding because apikit's pats table cannot be changed.

criteria.action: keep bindings in the SQLite table token_workspace_bindings with columns token_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL and created_at TEXT NOT NULL (an apikit.NowUTC timestamp), an index idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug on slug, and no foreign key to workspaces

criteria.condition: the binding schema initialisation runs on a database where token_workspace_bindings already exists
criteria.action: complete using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and leave every existing row unchanged
criteria.contract: returns a nil error; the row count before and after is equal

criteria.condition: MountWorkspaceHandlers runs
criteria.action: create the binding table right after the workspaces schema and before any route is registered
criteria.contract: the table exists before the first request is served

criteria.condition: MountGitHandlers runs on a database that lacks token_workspace_bindings
criteria.action: create the binding table before registering the git routes
criteria.contract: a PAT carrying a TokenID with no binding row is served by the git server without a 500

criteria.condition: creating the binding table fails in MountWorkspaceHandlers or MountGitHandlers
criteria.action: return the error from the mount function without registering further routes
criteria.contract: MountWorkspaceHandlers or MountGitHandlers returns a non-nil error

criteria.condition: a workspace is archived or deleted
criteria.action: leave every binding row that names its slug unchanged
criteria.contract: the token_workspace_bindings row count and contents are equal before and after the archive or delete

criteria.action: treat a PAT whose token id has no row in token_workspace_bindings as unbound

requirements.title: Resolving a binding
requirements.rationale: Every enforcing layer must agree on which token id is checked and must fail closed on a lookup error.

criteria.action: consider a binding only for an AuthInfo with CredentialType "pat" and key the lookup by AuthInfo.TokenID, issuing no binding query for api_key and admin_token credentials or a nil AuthInfo

criteria.condition: a PAT request has passed apikit authentication on an API-group route
criteria.action: take the token id from the Authorization header (scheme Bearer matched case-insensitively, the text between af_pat_ and the next _) and write the enriched AuthInfo back with apikit.SetAuthInfo
criteria.contract: apikit.GetAuthInfo in the handler returns the same AuthInfo with TokenID set to the parsed id

criteria.condition: no token id can be derived for a PAT (TokenID empty and the Authorization header missing, not of the form Bearer af_pat_<id>_<secret>, or with an empty id)
criteria.action: treat the PAT as unbound without issuing a binding query
criteria.contract: the request proceeds exactly as for an unbound PAT

criteria.action: resolve a binding with exactly one primary-key lookup on token_id per enforcing layer, never while a rows cursor or transaction is open on the same database handle
criteria.contract: on a single-connection (SetMaxOpenConns(1)) SQLite database every enforcing call returns within 5 seconds

criteria.condition: the binding lookup returns a database error
criteria.action: fail closed and never treat the token as unbound
criteria.contract: API routes answer HTTP 500 with message internal server error and the handler does not run; LookupBinding returns a non-nil error

requirements.title: Workspace-scoped API routes
requirements.rationale: To a bound token, every workspace other than S must not exist, regardless of scopes.

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route whose path template contains the segments workspaces/:slug
criteria.action: refuse the request before the handler runs, and so before any scope, existence or status check
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with the apikit error envelope and message workspace not found, the same body a non-owner receives

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route whose path template contains the segments workspaces/:slug
criteria.action: pass the request unchanged into the handler's own checks
criteria.contract: the status and body equal those an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes receives

criteria.action: for any bound token, any slug other than S, any workspace-scoped route and any scope set (including none), whether the slug exists, is owned or is archived, answer 404 workspace not found
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with message workspace not found, body identical to a non-owner's

criteria.action: install the binding guard with s.APIGroup().Use inside MountWorkspaceHandlers after MountHandlers and before RegisterRoutes, so that every route and subgroup registered on the API group afterwards, including /workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id, is guarded without further change

criteria.condition: wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace is called with a bound PAT for an existing workspace the caller owns
criteria.action: apply the binding rule after the existence and ownership checks and deny access
criteria.contract: returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found"); for slug S it returns the same access value as for an unbound PAT

criteria.condition: lookupWorkspaceForAuth is called with a bound PAT for an existing workspace the caller owns
criteria.action: deny access through the shared wsaccess rule
criteria.contract: writes HTTP 404 workspace not found and returns a non-nil error

criteria.condition: the binding lookup inside wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace or lookupWorkspaceForAuth fails with a database error
criteria.action: deny access
criteria.contract: AuthorizeWorkspace returns (nil, 500, "internal server error"); lookupWorkspaceForAuth writes HTTP 500

requirements.title: Default-deny for other hub API routes
requirements.rationale: A route nobody thought to confine must refuse a bound token rather than leak other workspaces.

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route that is not workspace-scoped
criteria.guard: the route's method and path template are not on the bound-token allowlist
criteria.action: refuse the request before the handler runs
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to workspace <S>

criteria.action: provide an allowlist registry fed with the *echo.Route values returned at registration and keyed by method plus path template, marked for exactly GET /workspaces, POST /sessions, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id, POST /sessions/:id/complete, POST /sessions/:id/usage, GET /sessions/:id/usage, GET /audit, GET /events and GET /sandbox-profiles

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route that is not workspace-scoped
criteria.guard: the route is on the bound-token allowlist
criteria.action: pass the request to the handler, which filters its result to S
criteria.contract: the handler runs; its response follows 33-REQ-6

criteria.condition: a bound token requests POST /workspaces, any /user/secrets or /user/vars route, any /orgs/:slug/secrets or /orgs/:slug/vars route, or GET /sandboxes
criteria.action: refuse the request whatever scopes the token holds
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound; no row is written

criteria.condition: a bound token requests a path under the API mount point that matches no registered route
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound

criteria.action: for any route registered on the API group after the guard that is neither workspace-scoped nor marked on the allowlist, refuse a bound token with 403 token_bound

criteria.condition: a request without credentials, or with an api_key, admin_token or unbound PAT credential, reaches the binding guard
criteria.action: pass the request to the next handler, issuing no binding query for requests without credentials, api_key or admin_token
criteria.contract: status and body equal those produced without the guard

requirements.title: Guarding apikit's own routes
requirements.rationale: A bound PAT holding tokens:manage could otherwise mint an unbound PAT through apikit's POST /user/tokens.

criteria.condition: MountWorkspaceHandlers calls s.MountHandlers
criteria.action: record as apikit routes the method and path template of every route in s.Echo().Routes() after the call that was absent before it, leaving out /healthz, /readyz and /version
criteria.contract: the recorded set includes GET <mount>/user and POST <mount>/user/tokens

criteria.condition: a request's method and path template match a recorded apikit route and it carries Authorization: Bearer af_pat_<token_id>_<secret>
criteria.action: refuse the request on the root Echo instance before apikit authenticates it, without naming the workspace
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to a workspace; the slug does not appear in the body

criteria.condition: a bound PAT holding tokens:manage sends POST /api/v1/user/tokens
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 token_bound; no new PAT is created in apikit's pats table

criteria.condition: a request matching a recorded apikit route carries no af_pat_ Bearer token or carries one whose id has no binding row
criteria.action: pass the request to apikit unchanged, issuing no binding query when no af_pat_ id is present
criteria.contract: status and body equal those apikit produces without the guard

criteria.action: only refuse or pass through: never grant access, never set AuthInfo and never hash or verify a token secret

criteria.condition: a request does not match a recorded apikit route
criteria.action: pass the request through without a binding query
criteria.contract: zero binding queries for that request at the root guard

criteria.condition: the apikit route guard's binding lookup fails with a database error
criteria.action: fail closed and not forward the request to apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

requirements.title: Cross-workspace views and sessions
requirements.rationale: A service needs to discover its workspace, report sessions and read its audit stream, yet must see only S.

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /workspaces
criteria.action: return at most workspace S, subject to the existing workspaces:read scope check and the include_archived filter
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 whose list contains S or nothing; other refusals unchanged

criteria.condition: a bound token sends POST /sessions with a workspace_slug other than S, or replays a session id that belongs to another workspace
criteria.action: refuse through requireWorkspaceRead and create no session
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /sessions/:id or GET /sessions/:id/usage for a session outside S, or GET /sessions?workspace_slug=<slug other than S>
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 workspace access denied

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /sessions without workspace_slug
criteria.action: list only sessions of workspace S
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 whose items all carry workspace_slug S

criteria.condition: a bound token sends POST /sessions/:id/complete or POST /sessions/:id/usage for a session whose workspace is not S
criteria.action: refuse the request, with RegisterSessionRoutes passing the SQLite handle to both handlers, and leave the session unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 not session owner

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /audit or GET /events
criteria.action: return only events of workspace S
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 (or the SSE stream) whose events all carry workspace S

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /audit?workspace=<slug other than S>
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /sandbox-profiles
criteria.action: answer exactly as for an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes
criteria.contract: status and body equal the unbound PAT's

requirements.title: The git server
requirements.rationale: Git access must honour the same binding as the REST API.

criteria.condition: a bound token requests a repository /git/<org>/<slug>.git through authorizeGitAccess
criteria.action: deny access after the admin and ownership checks
criteria.contract: pkt-line 404 repository not found, identical to a non-owner's response

criteria.condition: a bound token requests the repository of workspace S
criteria.action: let the existing git:read and git:write scope checks decide
criteria.contract: fetch and push outcomes equal those of an unbound PAT with the same scopes

criteria.condition: the git server's binding lookup fails with a database error
criteria.action: fail closed
criteria.contract: pkt-line 500 error; the repository is not served

criteria.condition: an api_key or admin_token credential requests a git repository
criteria.action: apply the existing checks without a binding query
criteria.contract: response identical to that before this spec

requirements.title: Audit ingestion
requirements.rationale: The KeyID branch of checkWorkspaceAccess assumed a binding nothing produced; the shared rule replaces it.

criteria.action: decide workspace access in checkWorkspaceAccess without reading auth.KeyID and never emit error_type workspace_mismatch

criteria.condition: a bound token posts to a run under /workspaces/<slug>/runs/:run_id where <slug> is not S
criteria.action: refuse the request and write no event
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found

criteria.condition: an unbound non-owner posts to a run of a workspace
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type workspace_access_denied

criteria.condition: the caller posts to a run of an archived workspace it may reach
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error_type workspace_archived

criteria.condition: the caller posts to a run of a workspace that does not exist
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404

criteria.condition: the audit routes are registered with a nil SQLite handle
criteria.action: skip the workspace access checks
criteria.contract: the event is accepted as before this spec

requirements.title: Unchanged behaviour and lifecycle
requirements.rationale: The binding may only narrow a bound token's reach; it must never move existing behaviour.

criteria.action: for any request by an unbound PAT, an API key or an admin token, return a status and body byte-identical to those without this spec, so that the ownership suites of internal/workspace, gitserver, carrypatch, merge, sandboxes, forge, secrets and audit pass unchanged except the two audit tests encoding the KeyID check
issue zero binding queries for requests authenticated with an api_key or admin_token credential
for any bound token, route and slug, allow a request only if an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes would be allowed it, so that a binding never widens a scope

criteria.condition: a bound token's workspace S is archived
criteria.action: let the token reach S and return that workspace's usual archived responses
criteria.contract: the same 400 or 409 an unbound owner PAT receives on S

criteria.condition: a bound token's workspace S has been deleted and its binding row remains
criteria.action: fail closed for the token
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found on every workspace-scoped route, HTTP 403 token_bound on every other non-allowlisted route, and pkt-line 404 repository not found in git

execution_paths.title: A bound token reads its own workspace and is refused another

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/S with Authorization: Bearer af_pat_<id>_<secret>
authenticates the PAT and sets AuthInfo
fills AuthInfo.TokenID if empty, looks up the binding, sees :slug equals S and passes the request on
calls lookupWorkspaceForAuth, which applies ownership and the binding rule, and returns 200 with workspace S
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/X/patches for another owned workspace X
answers 404 workspace not found before the handler runs

execution_paths.title: A bound token tries to mint an unbound PAT through apikit

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/user/tokens with a bound PAT holding tokens:manage
matches the route against the apikit route set recorded at startup and parses the token id from the Bearer header
finds a binding row and answers 403 token_bound with message this token is bound to a workspace
remains without a new token

execution_paths.title: A bound token hits a non-allowlisted hub route

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/user/secrets with a bound PAT
authenticates the PAT
finds the route neither workspace-scoped nor allowlisted and answers 403 token_bound naming S

execution_paths.title: A bound token discovers its workspace and reports a session

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces with a bound PAT
returns a list holding only S
sends POST /api/v1/sessions with workspace_slug S
creates the session and returns 201
sends GET /api/v1/audit
returns only events of S

execution_paths.title: A bound token uses the git server

steps.action: fetches /git/<org>/S.git with Basic auth carrying the bound PAT
resolves the PAT and sets AuthInfo.TokenID
calls authorizeGitAccess, which passes ownership and the binding, then the git:read scope check, and serves the pack
fetches /git/<org>/X.git for another owned workspace X
writes a pkt-line 404 repository not found
